zh:
曼彻斯特大学（The University of Manchester）成立于1824年，位于英国英格兰曼彻斯特市，是英国罗素大学集团核心成员，也是英国规模最大的单一校址公立研究型大学。学校下设6个学院，覆盖医学、法律、商学、工程、艺术、人文社科等领域，在校生超42000人，其中研究生约18000名。
曼彻斯特大学在2026QS世界大学排名中位列全球第35位，同时位列英国社会与环境影响力第1位。学校培养了25位诺贝尔奖得主、1位图灵奖得主，是近代原子物理、计算机科学等领域的重要发源地，石墨烯的发现地。学校在工程、材料科学、计算机科学、医学等领域拥有卓越的学术实力，毕业生雇主声誉长期位居英国前列。
en: The University of Manchester is a public research university in Manchester, England, UK. Founded in 1824, it is a core member of the Russell Group and the largest single-site university in the UK. The University comprises 6 faculties, covering medicine, law, business, engineering, arts, and humanities and social sciences, with over 42,000 enrolled students, including 18,000 graduate students. Ranked 35th globally in the 2026 QS World University Rankings, it is 1st in the UK for social and environmental impact. It has produced 25 Nobel Prize winners and 1 Turing Award winner, and is the birthplace of graphene, atomic physics, and modern computer science. Ranked No.35 in the world in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
